description: Find bookable surf lessons at SurfBooking beaches where current sea conditions match the given criteria: minimum wave height, minimum surf score, wind quality, and/or a specific level. Returns real upcoming lessons with date, time, spot, price and a booking link — only from spots where the sea ACTUALLY meets your threshold right now. Great for 'find beginner lessons when the sea is at least 1m', 'show lessons on days with light wind', or 'surf quando o mar tiver pelo menos 1.5m'. The scoring algorithm is proprietary and runs server-side. Read-only, SurfBooking zones with schools only: Portugal (14 zones with schools), Spain (1 zone with schools). Books or charges nothing. It always returns lessons, never a plain ranking of beaches.

days.description: How many days ahead to look for lessons (default 7, max 14).

level.description: Optional — only return lessons for this level.

lightWind.description: Optional — if true, only return spots where wind speed is currently ≤ 30 km/h.

scoreMin.description: Minimum SurfBooking score (0–10). Omit to skip score filter.

waveMin.description: Minimum wave height in metres, e.g. 1 or 1.5. Omit to skip wave filter.

zone.description: Optional — filter to a zone/region, e.g. 'Porto' or 'Ericeira'.

name: find_lessons_by_conditions
title: Lessons for the conditions
